title: 第5893章 认输第5892章 新矿脉
slug: 天域丹尊第5904章不堪一击
content_zh:
他们都对赌石不抱希望，选择赌石其实就相当于已经输了。
可又有什么办法呢，苏尘态度强势，他们没法反对。
“既然要赌石，怎么比？”
姜青鱼代表苏尘问。
“双方各选三块原石，全部解开之后，比拼总价值高低。”
陆飞宇一方有人开口说道。
“好。”
姜青鱼替苏尘答应了下来。
陆飞宇一方立刻派出了一名原石大师，此人被众人尊称为曹大师，单名一个康字，修为达到翻云境十重。
如今的他，被一众合道境奉为座上宾，可谓风光无限。
曹康神色十分矜持，对着苏尘淡淡说道：“我也不欺负你，允许你选十块原石，再与我比拼。”
这话很嚣张，却也符合现在原石大师的性格，他们被合道境们惯得越来越狂妄了。
苏尘却没有生气，微微一笑：“好啊。”
红发男子一行听到曹康这话，心中都燃起了一丝希望。
选十块原石，万一运气好一点，每块都能开出宝物，加起来的价值说不定就能超过曹康呢？
有时候，就算实力再强，遇到运气爆棚的对手，也只能自认倒霉。
“你先选吧。”
曹康神色高傲。
照理来说，像他这种翻云境根本连合道境的面都见不到，可如今却能让一众合道境环绕在身边，以上宾之礼相待。
这让他自我感觉好到了极点，几乎要飘上天了。

苏尘摇头，这种人哪有洞玄大师的智慧，现在仗着原石大师的身份横行一时，日后十有八九会横尸街头。
“好啊。”
他漫不经心的应道，一边随意走动，一边在这条新矿脉中随手挑选，很快就挖出了十块原石。
曹康也是慢吞吞走动起来，来回转了好几圈，反复打量挑选，才最终选定了三块原石。
红发男子等人见状，都是暗道没指望了。
你看，人家原石大师选石都如此谨慎，苏尘却只是随便找了十块石头，这根本没有可比性啊。
“开石吧。”
曹康淡淡开口，摆足了原石大师的架子。
“好啊。”
苏尘应声开石。
他的力量何等浑厚，而且对原石内部的宝物了若指掌，仅仅几个呼吸的时间，原石里的东西就显露了出来。
那是一株大药，通体绿色，品相极佳。
靠！
看到这一幕，在场众人全都惊呆了。
这运气也太逆天了吧，随便捡一块石头，都能开出绝世大药？
红发男子一行又重新燃起了希望，绿色大药极为珍贵，哪怕苏尘接下来的九块原石全是废石，说不定只凭这一株大药都能赢得比试。
陆飞宇等人则是嘴角抽搐，暗自吐槽自己这边有原石大师又如何，架不住对手运气这么好啊？
曹康更是嘴巴半张，满脸错愕。
他不是洞玄大师那种初代原石大师，只是初代原石大师的徒子徒孙，在赌石上虽然有几分门道，但实力和眼界是远远比不上洞玄大师的。
他只知道自己选的三块原石里面有宝物，可具体是什么，他却一无所知。

苏尘一出手就是一株绿色大药，彻底打乱了他的阵脚，让他开始慌了起来。
content_en:
They all have no hope of gambling on stones. Choosing to gamble on stones is actually equivalent to losing.
But what can they do? Su Chen has a strong attitude and they can't object.
"Since we want to bet on stones, how can we compare?"
Jiang Qingyu asked on behalf of Su Chen.
"Each side chooses three rough stones. After unlocking them all, they will compete for the total value."
Someone on Lu Feiyu's side said.
"Okay."
Jiang Qingyu agreed on behalf of Su Chen.
Lu Feiyu's side immediately sent out a master of raw stones. This person was respectfully called Master Cao by everyone. His name was Kang, and his cultivation had reached the tenth level of the cloud-turning realm.
Nowadays, he is regarded as a guest by everyone in the Hedao Realm, and he has unlimited glory.
Cao Kang looked very reserved and said calmly to Su Chen: "I will not bully you. I allow you to choose ten rough stones and then compete with me."
These words are very arrogant, but they are also in line with the character of the current rough stone masters. They are becoming more and more arrogant by the Hedao realm.
Su Chen was not angry, and smiled slightly: "Okay."
When the red-haired man and his party heard Cao Kang's words, a glimmer of hope ignited in their hearts.
Choose ten rough stones. If you are lucky, each stone can yield a treasure, and the combined value may exceed Cao Kang's?
Sometimes, no matter how strong you are, you can only admit that you are unlucky when you encounter an opponent who is extremely lucky.
"You choose first."
Cao Kang looked arrogant.
Logically speaking, a person like him at the Cloud-turning Realm would not be able to see anyone at the Hedao Realm, but now he can have people at the Hedao Realm surround him and treat him like a distinguished guest.
This made him feel so good about himself that he almost floated to the sky.
Su Chen shook his head. How could such a person have the wisdom of Master Dongxuan? Now he is running rampant for a while relying on his identity as Master of Original Stone, and there is a high probability that he will die on the streets in the future.
"Okay."
He responded casually, walking around casually while picking at this new mineral vein, and soon dug out ten rough stones.
Cao Kang also walked slowly, walked back and forth several times, looked at the selection repeatedly, and finally selected three rough stones.
When the red-haired man and others saw this, they secretly said that there was no hope.
You see, the rough stone masters are so careful in selecting stones, but Su Chen just randomly found ten stones. There is no comparison at all.
"Open the stone."
Cao Kang spoke calmly, putting on the airs of Master Yuanshi.
"Okay."
Su Chen opened the stone in response.
His power is so strong, and he is so familiar with the treasures inside the original stone. In just a few breaths, the contents of the original stone are revealed.
It was a big medicinal plant, all green and in excellent condition.
Depend on!
Seeing this scene, everyone present was shocked.
This kind of luck is so unbelievable, right? Just pick up a stone and you can prescribe a unique medicine?
The red-haired man and his party rekindled hope. The green medicine was extremely precious. Even if Su Chen's next nine rough stones were all waste rocks, they might be able to win the competition with just this medicine.
Lu Feiyu and others twitched at the corners of their mouths, secretly complaining that it didn't matter if they had a rough stone master on their side. How could they not be so lucky against their opponents?
Cao Kang's mouth was half-opened, his face full of astonishment.
He is not the first-generation original stone master like Master Dongxuan, but the disciple and grandson of the first-generation original stone master. Although he has some skills in stone gambling, his strength and vision are far inferior to Master Dongxuan.
He only knew that the three rough stones he chose contained treasures, but he had no idea what they were.
As soon as Su Chen took action, he unleashed a big green medicine, which completely disrupted his position and made him panic.
